references: Lidia Pivovarova, Tinka Rainio, and Eetu Mäkelä. Leveraging LLM-Generated Translations to Guide Verse Representation Learning in Finnic Oral Poetry. Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027.
title: FILTER verse embeddings: DeepSeek 3 translations, word analyses and paper data
description: Archived DeepSeek 3 verse translations and word analyses in their existing public Parquet format, plus the exact cleaned paper snapshot (4,311,544 rows; 291,227 poems). The support archive contains frozen split assignments, retrieval positives, tokenizers, corpus metadata and cleaning provenance. Generated translations, analyses and release-specific processing outputs are CC BY 4.0; original corpus text and metadata retain their upstream terms. The public word table has 14,618,529 rows; its original training word IDs and row order remain unverified, as documented in README.md and readiness.json. These existing artifacts are preserved without regenerating translations.
